_comment: Corrections applied on top of the HAPI-generated field data. Each entry records its evidence. Only add entries backed by a real v2.5.1 source.

fields.evidence: Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 PID.38: rpt 2, table 0429 (spot check 2026-10-19). HAPI 2.5.1 records rpt 1 and no table; the original curated data also had rpt 2.
Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 SCH.11 usage B (backward compatible; TQ1/TQ2 replace TQ). HAPI only distinguishes R/O and records O. The original curated data wrongly had R.
Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 MRG.2 usage B, length 250 (HAPI length 250). The original curated data had length 20.
Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 MRG.4 usage B, length 250 (HAPI length 250). The original curated data had length 20.
Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 OBX.15 name 'Producer's ID' (CE), matching the original curated data. HAPI 2.5.1 names it 'Producer's Reference'.

Caristix HL7-Definition v2.5.1 table 0123 lists only A, C, F, I, O, P, R, S, X, Y, Z (spot check 2026-10-19); the FHIR STU3 table (v2.1–v2.8.2 history) does not list N either.
